what: Round-1 baseline no-op is specified as path equality but wiring always uses a separate baseline file
scenario_or_breakage: Round 1 copies plan.txt to plan-review-baseline.txt and passes both paths to render-plan-review-prompt.sh; the proposed degrade guard is only when --baseline-plan-file equals --plan-file, so the drift-compare block always fires even when contents are identical, contradicting the edge-case contract and adding noise on every first review
suggested_fix: Skip the baseline block when cmp -s baseline plan (or hashes match), not only when argv paths are the same string; update the edge-case text to match
